content.text:
I tidied up `0.html` without changing how it looks on a normal desktop screen: it is still a 400px black circle centred on the page. I haven't opened it in a browser to check.

- **No stray scrollbar:** the body no longer uses `width: 100vw`, which can cause horizontal scrolling, and uses `min-height: 100dvh` (with a `100vh` fallback) so centring stays correct on mobile.
- **Scales on small screens:** the circle shrinks to fit viewports narrower or shorter than 400px instead of being clipped.
- **Accessible to screen readers:** the SVG now has `role="img"` and a `<title>` of "Circle", which I chose as a placeholder name.
- **Small CSS hygiene:** I added `box-sizing: border-box` to the reset and `display: block` on the SVG.

I left the page title and the `ae683f770` id alone, since they look generated. I also did not add dark-mode support, because that would change the appearance.
